context: Retired the 07-24 verify-agent mutation warning via #40 relates_to resolution; discovered why it kept surfacing — this machine's sessions run the repo's dist/ via the npm-link global, and dist was stale at Jul 24 (pre-2.6.0 assemble fixes). Rebuilt dist; restart applies both the fresh server and plugin 1.24.1.
rationale: The #40 predicate (computeResolvedIds) is the twining-native retirement: any live entry back-referencing the id resolves it, assemble drops it (2.6.0+), and the next age-based archive sweep moves it out since resolved warnings lose their age exemption. twining_archive's keep_open_needs_warnings:false alternative would force-sweep ALL open warnings, including the live 08-04 worktree-isolation guidance that must keep surfacing.
summary: Retired the 07-24 mutation warning with a relates_to resolution post rather than a forced archive sweep
